title: Circuit space components
statement: For each natural number $K_0$, the circuit-space components are: a radius into $X$ for each search phase; a length parameter $Lg$ into $X$ for each phase; each of the $K_0$ additions of $X$ into $w$ for each phase; $w$ into the shift counter $C$ for each phase; two components for placing $K$ into the base $Bs$, each indexed by a phase; access components for placing the base $Bs$ and an index into $T$, each indexed by a site; an iteration component placing $s$ into $s1$; and the component types described above.
hypotheses_covered: the addition component is indexed by $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(K_0)$
phase-indexed components range over the three search phases
access components are indexed by a site
